keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «공기가 우주로 천천히 새어 나가고 있었다(문제)» 와 «똑똑한 아이디어가 우주 정거장을 구했다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (air was slowly leaking out into space) and the solution (a smart idea saved the space station). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: A space rock made a hole, and air was leaking out.
Yuna used water drops to find the hole and covered it.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

opts: A space rock made a hole in the wall.
Yuna spilled water on the floor.
evs: A tiny piece of space rock had made a hole in the wall!
"We have twenty minutes," said the computer.
She let a few small drops of water float in the air.
The alarm stopped, and the whole crew cheered.
why: 작은 우주 돌멩이가 벽에 구멍을 내서 경보가 울렸어요. 컴퓨터가 고장 났다거나 유나가 물을 쏟았다는 말은 없어요.
A tiny piece of space rock made a hole in the wall, so the alarm rang. Nothing says the computer broke or that Yuna spilled water.

qs.q: The story says, "Air was slowly leaking out into space." What does "leaking out" mean here?
qs.qko: "Air was slowly leaking out into space."라는 문장이 있어요. 여기서 "leaking out"은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: escaping little by little through a hole
evs: Slowly, the drops moved toward the wall, pulled by the leaking air.
One morning, a red light flashed, and an alarm rang loudly.
Ten minutes were left, and everyone was getting scared.
Commander Yuna was the youngest astronaut on the space station.
why: 공기가 벽의 작은 구멍으로 빠져나가고 있었어요. 그래서 물방울도 그 공기에 끌려 벽 쪽으로 움직였어요. «leaking out»은 «조금씩 새어 나가다»라는 뜻이에요.
Air was going out through a small hole in the wall, and it even pulled the water drops toward the wall. «Leaking out» means escaping little by little.

qs.q: How did the water drops help Yuna find the hole?
qs.qko: 물방울은 유나가 구멍을 찾는 데 어떻게 도움이 되었나요?
opts: The leaking air pulled the drops toward the hole.
The drops turned red near the hole.
The drops made a loud sound.
evs: Slowly, the drops moved toward the wall, pulled by the leaking air.
The crew searched every room, but they could not find the hole.
"There it is!" Yuna shouted, and she covered the hole with special tape.
One morning, a red light flashed, and an alarm rang loudly.
why: 물방울들이 새어 나가는 공기에 끌려 벽 쪽으로 움직였고, 유나는 그곳에서 «저기다!» 하고 구멍을 찾았어요. 두 문장을 이으면 답이 나와요.
The drops were pulled toward the wall by the leaking air, and Yuna shouted «There it is!» where they went. Put these two sentences together to find the answer.

ends: Yuna teaches young astronauts her water drop trick.
유나가 어린 우주 비행사들에게 물방울 비법을 가르쳐 줘요.
The crew builds a strong wall cover to stop space rocks.
대원들이 우주 돌멩이를 막는 튼튼한 벽 덮개를 만들어요.

write.src: “Let’s <u>find the hole</u> before <u>the air runs out</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그보다 나중에 일어날 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what to do together and what happens later in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «before» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 써 보세요. (예: before the bell rings)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «before», write who + what. (e.g. before the bell rings)

img.cover: Inside a space station lit by a flashing red light, a young Korean woman astronaut with a short black ponytail and a white space suit with red stripes floats beside a line of shiny water drops drifting toward a tiny hole in the white wall, while two other astronauts in white space suits watch with hopeful faces.

scenes.1: In a space station hallway lit by a flashing red light, a young Korean woman astronaut with a short black ponytail and a white space suit with red stripes and two other astronauts in white space suits search behind panels and under tables with worried faces, while the blue Earth shines through a round window.
scenes.3: A young Korean woman astronaut with a short black ponytail and a white space suit with red stripes presses a piece of silver tape over the tiny hole in the wall, and two other astronauts in white space suits float around her, cheering with their arms in the air.

alt.1: Astronauts search the space station under a red light.
alt.3: An astronaut covers the hole with tape as the crew cheers.
